description: This Java class 'TestingUtils' provides utility functions for testing engine charts, waveforms, and related components in the Rusefi project. It includes methods for assertions, handling engine charts, and interacting with hardware state. The class appears to be used in testing scenarios involving engine simulation or hardware testing.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: Utility class containing static methods for testing engine chart data, waveforms, and hardware interactions in the Rusefi engine control project.
